subject: Recap: Redwood pricing & monthly spend band — Orchard Health follow-up
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Rivera <ellie@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 May 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Redwood pricing & monthly spend band — Orchard Health follow-up

Hi Ellie — thanks again for the call today. Quick written recap so we have alignment and clear next steps.

Key points from the demo & discovery
- Expected steady-state inference volume: based on your description and the token sample, our rough working estimate is 150M - 400M tokens/month (mix of short assistant responses + longer analytic runs).
- Cost sensitivity target: you mentioned a preferred target in the $/1M-token range; we proposed an initial ballpark of $320–$420 per 1M tokens depending on model selection and any committed discount.
- Illustrative monthly spend band (no commit): at $350/1M tokens, that maps to roughly $52.5k — $140k/month across the 150M–400M range (useful for finance planning).

Procurement considerations you flagged
- Procurement PO trigger: you noted that formal PO + procurement review typically kicks in above your $75k/month threshold.
- Pilot terms: to keep the pilot lightweight we recommended a month-to-month pilot under $75k or a short 3-month commit to unlock a reserved capacity discount.

What I'll send next (by EOD):
- A compact cost sensitivity table that maps model variants (small / standard / large) to $/1M and monthly spend at 100M/200M/300M token points.
- A sample SOW draft and an example PO/terms template suitable for your procurement team.
- A request for 7 days of token logs (redacted) so we can refine the estimate and recommend batch/quantization settings.

Immediate asks for your side
- Can you confirm the procurement PO trigger (is $75k/month the right threshold or is it $50k)?
- Please attach a 7‑day snip of token counts if possible (even a CSV of timestamps + token counts is fine).

Next steps and owners
- Alex (me): send sensitivity table + SOW draft + sample PO (today).
- Karthik: provide recommended reserved-band discount tiers and estimated $/1M under 3-, 6-, 12-month commits (tomorrow).
- Ellie / Procurement: confirm PO threshold and procurement point-of-contact.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: sample_token_extract.csv (please send a 7-day extract if available)
From: Ellie Rivera <ellie@orchardhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Lowe <tim.lowe@orchardhealth.com>, procurement@orchardhealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 09:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood pricing & monthly spend band — Orchard Health follow-up

Thanks Alex — appreciate the recap and the clear asks. A few clarifications from procurement & product: 

1) Procurement thresholds
- Confirmed: formal PO required for monthly commit > $75k. Anything below that can usually be done via credit card or a simple contract addendum. For annualized commitments > $900k we route through Procurement + Legal as an RFP.

2) Usage detail (helpful context)
- Our rough internal breakdown: baseline support chat ~90M tokens/month, nightly analytics jobs ~80M, experimental large-context runs ~50M when triggered — total ~220M/month typical with spikes to ~350M in campaign weeks.

3) Requests from our finance team
- Can you provide a one-page sensitivity table that shows total monthly cost at $/1M = 320, 350, 400, and 450 for 100M / 200M / 300M token points?
- We also need to see the delta if you include a reserved-band discount (example: 10% on $/1M for a 3-month commit; 20% for 6+ months).

4) Billing / payment terms
- Procurement prefers Net30 invoices and a PO number on each invoice. Are Net30 + PO acceptable?

We'll attach a 7-day token extract — see sample_token_extract.csv (redacted) attached. Tim (cc'd) is our procurement lead; he should be the contact for the formal PO.

Ellie
Director of Product, Orchard Health
ellie@orchardhealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

Attachment: sample_token_extract.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Recap: Redwood pricing & monthly spend band — Orchard Health follow-up

Looping in pricing/solutions detail. Alex — I put together three scenarios in the attached workbook (pricing-scenarios-20280509.xlsx):

- Scenario A (no commit): list prices at ${320,350,400}/1M and per-month totals for 100/200/300/400M tokens.
- Scenario B (3-month reserve): 10% off list for committed band, payment monthly, Net30.
- Scenario C (6+ month reserve): 18% off list and optional dedicated pool for guaranteed throughput (adds fixed monthly pool fee).

Notes to include in the SOW draft:
- Pilot proposal: 1-month pilot capped at $75k to avoid PO trigger (OR use a 3-month 10% reserved commit if they prefer predictable costs).
- Invoice & PO: we can support Net30 and put PO # on invoices. Legal prefers minimal redlines on standard SOW; I'll attach a first-pass SOW (SOW-redwood-orchard-draft.docx).

Alex — can you send the one-pager sensitivity table to Ellie and Tim ASAP and attach the workbook + SOW? I can follow with the formal quote and commit language once we confirm their preferred band.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing-scenarios-20280509.xlsx, SOW-redwood-orchard-draft.docx

Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood pricing & monthly spend band — Orchard Health follow-up

All — this looks good. Quick responses / asks so we can get Procurement moving: 

- PO trigger confirmed at $75k/month. If you can keep the pilot capped at $75k we've got a fast lane to approve.
- Please send the one-page sensitivity table (requested ranges) + the 1-page SOW summary we can attach to a PO. If pricing options show the 3-month 10% discount, include the monthly invoice amount so finance can sign off quickly.
- Tim (procurement) — I've added you explicitly; please advise if you want a formal quote template.

If you can send the one-pager and SOW summary by EOD Mon (5/13) we should be able to get an internal approval slack channel and a PO raised by Wed.

Thanks,
Ellie
